newsitem.title: USA: Time Warner, Turner put team together.
newsitem.headline: Time Warner, Turner put team together.

text.p: Time Warner Inc and Turner Broadcasting System Inc said Tuesday they have put together an operating structure and management team that would put in place a cable networks group under the leadership of Ted Turner, who would serve as vice chairman of Time Warner.

R.E. Turner, chairman and president of Turner Broadcasting, also confirmed news reports that Scott Sassa, president of the company's Turner Entertainment Group and a member of its board of directors, will be resigning.
The resignation is effective once the merger, which was approved last week by the Federal Trade Commission, is completed.

Under the other management changes, Ted Turner will have a number of executives reporting to him: Jeff Bewkes, chairman, president and chief executive of Home Box Office; Tom Johnson, chairman, president and chief executive of Cable News Network; and Terry McGuirk, who will become chairman, president and chief executive of TBS Inc.
